method: Independent re-check in the Higgsfield sandbox: live Commons API for all 20 file pages (wikitext, extmetadata, full revision history, upload/deletion logs, talk pages, deletion-request searches, sha1/size), curl -sIL of every media_url (all HTTP 200, Content-Length equal to Commons imageinfo size), rendered Template:PD-algorithm and the VulcanSphere licence template with history, Wayback captures of the three YouTube source pages (CC BY labels, upload dates), OpenAI's Wayback Sora page plus HEAD/ffprobe of the developer CDN originals, DeepMind's hosted Owl clip, the Calhoun Press blog capture, generator terms (Runway ToS live + Wayback 2023-03-31, Hailuo payment policy live + Wayback 2024-12-09, CompVis LICENSE, CogVideoX MODEL_LICENSE, LTX 0.9.5 licence) and primary release pages (Google Research, blog.google, Runway, Stability GitHub, MiniMax, xAI, THUDM/Lightricks READMEs). Watermark/overlay statements come from temporal-median/temporal-std/Sobel pixel analysis; no video frame was viewed by me. Uploader credibility read from Commons user records.
global_notes: All 20 media URLs return HTTP 200 with the stated content-type and a Content-Length equal to the Commons imageinfo size; sha1 of every Commons file is recorded in corrected_fields.commons_sha1 for archiving.

The PD-algorithm tag is a Commons assertion (importer/uploader), not a legal finding; its rendered text itself warns that the UK and Hong Kong give computer-generated works 50 years and that AI outputs may be derivative of training data. No developer (OpenAI, Google) publishes a reuse licence for these demo clips; where a verdict rests on PD-algorithm it is 'clear_with_conditions' with an explicit residual-risk acceptance, and vendor promotional clips that are YouTube rips or possibly assembled sequences are rejected.

Explicit creator grants (CC0 by uploader-generator, CC BY / CC BY-SA by the creator) are the strongest tier: DeepDream Ouroboros, VulcanSphere clips, Benlisquare, Lwneal, Oronbb, Sorelius Beats, Vincent Chang Deng. Their limits are upstream inputs and generator terms, recorded per clip.

Deletion exposure: Commons deletes unused AI files on scope grounds (Sora clip Suv-in-the-dust deleted 2026-07-04; Hailuo 'Drone View of Night Cyberpunk City' deleted 2026-04-25). Files unused on any wiki: DeepDream x2, EXECUTE, Sora pigeon, CogVideoX, Veo 2 clock, Veo 3.1 Kei. Archive masters now.

Corrections to the hunter: (1) EXECUTE's CC BY label IS verifiable via Wayback 2024-10-04; (2) DeepMind's Veo page does state the Owl clip was generated 'without modifications' and hosts the identical 22.667 s file; (3) the Veo 2 clock's CC0 tag was added 11 months after upload; (4) the Sora train import was an 'uploads:' stash import, not cdn.openai.com; (5) the Stability 'Aug 22' post has a 2022-08-22 Wayback capture; (6) the VideoPoet clip lacks provenance (asset hash differs from the current site) and carries a burned-in overlay; (7) the Hailuo clip carries a burned-in overlay and free-tier terms.
No frame was viewed; every visual statement is metadata or pixel analysis. Watermark heuristics are weak on near-static scenes (Veo 2 clock, Sora train, CogVideoX swans, Gen-2 dog).

Google's VideoPoet page (fetched 2026-09-29) contains no reuse licence and no statement that the clip is unmodified model output. The United Kingdom and Hong Kong provide a limited term of copyright protection for computer-generated works of 50 years from creation.' plus an 'AI derivative works' legal disclaimer (models trained on copyrighted works can output derivative content).

Provenance mismatch found: the current VideoPoet page lists 'dog_popcorn_with_audio_B75FD15C.mp4', but the Commons file was imported from an older asset 'dog_popcorn_with_audio_6781BD0C.mp4' on storage.googleapis.com/googwebreview.appspot.com (HEAD 200, 115,581 bytes, last-modified Wed, 20 Dec 2023 01:25:27 GMT). The Commons page has no caption; the hunter mapped the caption 'A dog eating popcorn at the cinema' by file name only.

The demo section is 'Video-to-audio: VideoPoet can also output audio to match an input video without using any text as guidance.' It does not say the picture was generated by VideoPoet, so the clip cannot be shown as VideoPoet video generation, and the hunter's 'earliest native-audio-style demo' framing is unsupported (audio was added to an existing video).

Burned-in overlay found: a static high-contrast block at bottom-right (bbox about x 73-98 %, y 87-99 % of the 512x896 frame; 3,266 static edge pixels; looks like a text/caption box, text not read). Any 9:16 use must keep it; content of the text unknown. Hunter recorded 'unknown'.
Technical: 2.184 s, 17 frames at 8 fps, 512x896, mono Opus; 241,051 bytes - extremely low value as a hero excerpt.

A sibling VideoPoet file's deletion request (Cat piano with audio 3EB0CD1F, closed 'Kept' 2025-12-30 on scope grounds) contains an IP comment 'This doesn't seem generated by uploader'; no licence finding either way.
Model release date itself is corroborated (Google Research blog dated December 19, 2023); the rejection is for licence basis + provenance + overlay.
